capabilities: Sync new, changed and deleted files in both directions over LAN
Pair devices with a QR code or pasted connection string
Review conflicts with previews and word-level diffs
Protect deletions with tombstone manifest entries
Transfer up to six files in parallel
extras: Traffic is plain HTTP and the bearer token is stored in plain text in data.json; sync is manual only, with no background watcher or interval sync; tombstones are kept indefinitely and clearing them is irreversible; the README says the plugin is not yet published in the community directory and real screenshots are still to come.
problem: Moving vault changes between a desktop and a phone normally needs a cloud service or account, and there is no direct device-to-device transfer over the local network.

relations.evidence: Desktop and phone on the same LAN, or connected through a VPN such as Tailscale or ZeroTier.

summary: Syncs a vault bidirectionally between a desktop and a phone over the local network, with tombstone deletion protection and an interactive conflict review window.
